Titanium Dioxide Supplier for Spain

Malaysia-origin titanium dioxide for industrial procurement in Spain. Explore grades for coatings, plastics and masterbatch applications, or send us your application, quantity and delivery requirements for a quotation.

Request a Quote

Explore Products

Review TiO2 for Your Application

Coatings

Start with your coating system and end use—such as decorative, construction or industrial applications—then compare the relevant grade properties on the product pages.

Whether the system is waterborne or solvent-borne, and whether it is intended for indoor or outdoor use, can help define what you need to evaluate.

TiO2 for Coatings

Plastics & Masterbatch

Start with the resin, processing route and finished product. For example, a packaging film or bag, construction profile, compound or masterbatch may require different evaluation priorities.

Evaluating TiO2 directly in a plastic product → TiO2 for Plastics

Producing a TiO2 masterbatch → TiO2 for Masterbatch

Explore Products

Documents for Your Product Review

For a grade you are evaluating, request the TDS, SDS, COA or origin documentation your team needs for review. Select the product grade and document types on the request form.

A Certificate of Origin is available upon request.

Request Documents

View Document Hub

Request a Quote for Delivery to Spain

Share the details needed to review your request:

  • Your application and product grade or requirements.
  • Required or estimated quantity in metric tonnes (MT).
  • Delivery location in Spain, with a city, port or receiving point if known.
  • Packaging, timing or document needs, if known.

If you have not selected a grade, choose “Not sure / Need help” in the quotation form. Add your company details and business contact information so we can respond to your request.

Request a Quote

After you submit your quotation request, our team will review your requirements and contact you using the details provided.
